name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention and accurately describes the job: load one resource entry from a packed DAT archive file. No Ghidra address residue in the name. Verified against decompilation, disassembly, and the source body (fopen DAT name + seek/read of an indexed offset pair + malloc/fread of payload).
purpose: Central resource loader: open a packed DAT archive, look up resource <index> in its 32-bit offset table, and fread its payload into a freshly malloc'd buffer (freeing the caller's old buffer first).
logic_summary:
1) If old_buf!=0, free(old_buf). 2) fp=fopen(fname,"rb"); if NULL -> printf("

 File not found %s!!! 

",fname)+exit(1) (tail-JMP into _main's shared printf(%s)+exit stub @0x1005e). 3) Allocate an 8-byte temp, fseek to file offset index*4+6, fread 8 bytes = [u32 start, u32 end]. 4) data_fd2_resource_last_loaded_resource_size @0x53BFF = end - start; free temp. 5) buf=malloc(size); if NULL -> printf("Out of Memory at Load %s Number:%d!!
",fname,index)+exit(1). 6) fseek(fp,start,SEEK_SET); fread(buf,1,size,fp); fclose(fp). 7) return buf. The 8-byte header is heap-allocated then freed (the binary uses a malloc'd temp, not a stack buffer); source mirrors this exactly.
signature: uint32 fd2_load_dat_resource(uint32 fname, uint32 old_buf, uint32 index)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Pointer to the NUL-terminated DAT filename string passed to fopen (e.g. FDTXT.DAT / FDOTHER.DAT / FDFIELD.DAT / FDSHAP.DAT / DATO.DAT / FDMUS.DAT). In src it is already named 'fname'.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_1; rename (in Stage 2) to the descriptive 'fname' already used in src. Used only as (char*)fname for fopen/printf.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Previous resource buffer pointer to be free()'d before the new load (0 = none). Callers pass the same global slot they store the return value into, giving free-old-then-replace semantics. In src it is already named 'old_buf'.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_2; rename (in Stage 2) to the descriptive 'old_buf' already used in src. Body uses it only in the leading `if (old_buf!=0) free(old_buf)`.

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: Zero-based resource index into the archive's 32-bit offset table; the header offset pair is read at file offset index*4+6. In src it is already named 'index'.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_3; rename (in Stage 2) to the descriptive 'index' already used in src. Used as index*4+6 for the fseek and echoed in the OOM printf.

returns.semantics: Pointer (as uint32) to the freshly malloc'd buffer holding the loaded resource payload. Both failure paths (fopen NULL, malloc NULL) exit(1) instead of returning, so a normal return is always a valid buffer. Caller also reads data_fd2_resource_last_loaded_resource_size for the byte size of this buffer.

reads_globals: data_fd2_resource_last_loaded_resource_size (read-back at the malloc and fread size args within the same call)
writes_globals: data_fd2_resource_last_loaded_resource_size (@0x53BFF = end - start; size of the resource just loaded; later also read by fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade @0x25a07 to DPMI-lock the FDMUS sequence)
